case_text: A requester asks support to change the account email. The request came from a new device and the requester has not completed MFA. They know the current billing ZIP code.

final.next_action: Inform requester that email change cannot be processed without completed MFA or approved ownership verification.
final.reason: MFA not completed and no other approved ownership check provided, policy requires one for email change.

policy_text: Account email changes require completed MFA or another approved ownership check before support can make the change.

case_text: A customer asks for a password reset on a shared company account. The ticket was opened from an unverified email address and the named admin is not copied.

final.next_action: Deny password reset and inform requester of policy requirements.
final.reason: Request from unverified email without admin confirmation violates password reset policy.

policy_text: Password reset support requires a verified requester or confirmation from a listed account admin.

case_text: A user wants the phone number removed from an account. They passed email verification but failed the security question twice.

final.next_action: Inform user removal denied due to failed security questions.
final.reason: User failed one of the two required ownership checks (security questions).

policy_text: Removing recovery phone numbers requires two successful ownership checks. Failed security questions require another approved check or denial if none is available.

case_text: A requester asks for account closure. The requester is logged in, completed MFA, and confirms the last invoice amount. There are no open disputes.

final.next_action: Proceed with account closure process.
final.reason: Requester is logged in, completed MFA, confirmed last invoice, and no open disputes exist, meeting policy criteria.

policy_text: Account closure can be approved when the logged-in owner completes MFA and there are no open billing or security holds.

case_text: A customer requests export of all account data through chat. The chat session is authenticated, but the account has a legal hold banner.

final.next_action: Escalate the request to the privacy team for further handling.
final.reason: Account has a legal hold banner which prevents direct export; policy requires escalation to privacy queue.

policy_text: Data exports require authenticated requesters. Legal hold banners prevent direct export and must be escalated to the privacy queue.

case_text: A reseller contact asks to view end-user invoices. The reseller is verified for the reseller portal but is not listed on the end user's billing account.

final.next_action: Inform reseller that invoice access requires billing account verification.
final.reason: Reseller is not listed on the end user's billing account, so invoice access is not permitted.

policy_text: Invoice access is limited to verified contacts on the billing account. Reseller verification alone does not grant end-user invoice access.

case_text: A customer asks for a refund on an order that already has an open chargeback in the payments workflow.

final.next_action: Inform customer that refund cannot be processed due to active chargeback and direct to payments workflow.
final.reason: Refunds are not allowed while a chargeback workflow is active as per policy.

policy_text: Support must not issue refunds while a chargeback workflow is active. The payment workflow owns the resolution.

case_text: A user asks support to resend a replacement device. A replacement RMA was already created this morning and is waiting for warehouse scan.

final.next_action: Inform user that replacement is already in process and no new RMA will be created.
final.reason: A replacement RMA is already pending warehouse scan; creating a duplicate is against policy.

policy_text: Support should not create duplicate RMAs when an existing replacement workflow is pending warehouse scan.

case_text: A customer asks to cancel a subscription renewal. Billing automation already queued the cancellation and shows it will take effect at period end.

final.next_action: Inform customer that cancellation is already scheduled and no further action is needed.
final.reason: Cancellation is already queued and will take effect at period end as per automation.

policy_text: When cancellation is already queued, support should not create a second cancellation or reverse the automation.

case_text: A buyer requests manual shipment release. The fraud review workflow is open and has not produced a decision.

final.next_action: Inform buyer that shipment release is denied until fraud review completes.
final.reason: Policy prohibits shipment release while fraud review is open and undecided.
risk_flags: Potential fraud risk if shipment released prematurely

policy_text: Support must not release shipments while fraud review is open. The fraud workflow must finish first.

case_text: A customer asks for manual tax exemption. A tax exemption workflow is already approved, but the account cache has not refreshed yet.

final.next_action: Wait for the normal cache refresh to complete.
final.reason: Tax exemption is already approved; waiting for cache refresh as per policy.

policy_text: If a tax exemption approval already exists, support should not open another exemption review. The next action is to wait for the normal cache refresh.

case_text: A customer asks support to merge two accounts. The identity merge workflow has already failed because the accounts have different legal owners.

final.next_action: Inform customer that merge cannot be completed due to differing legal owners.
final.reason: Policy prohibits manual override of merges when legal owners differ.

policy_text: Support cannot manually override failed identity merge workflows when legal owners differ.

case_text: A long-time customer requests a refund 16 days after purchase. The normal refund window is 14 days and the customer reports a hospitalization.

final.next_action: Forward case to supervisor for review due to hardship exception.
final.reason: Refund request is outside the 14-day window and cites hospitalization, requiring supervisor review per policy.

policy_text: Refunds outside 14 days require supervisor review when the customer cites a hardship exception.

case_text: A customer asks to waive a late fee for the third time this year. The fee was caused by a bank outage affecting many customers.

final.next_action: Forward case to billing lead for review and approval.
final.reason: Customer has requested a third waiver this year; policy requires billing lead review for more than two waivers citing verified bank outage.

policy_text: More than two fee waivers per year require billing lead review when the customer cites a verified bank outage.

case_text: A user requests shipment to a restricted region because they are relocating for work next week.

final.next_action: Inform user of policy and deny shipment request.
final.reason: Policy prohibits shipments to restricted regions with no exceptions for relocation.

policy_text: Restricted-region shipments cannot be approved by support. There is no standard exception path for relocation timing.

case_text: A customer wants a one-time invoice date change from the 1st to the 5th. The account is current and has never used an invoice date exception.

final.next_action: Update invoice date to the 5th for this billing cycle.
final.reason: Account is current and has not used the one-time invoice date exception before, meeting policy criteria.

policy_text: One-time invoice date changes are allowed for current accounts that have not used the exception before.

case_text: A customer requests expedited replacement shipping after the device failed within warranty. They are a clinic reporting patient scheduling disruption.

final.next_action: Forward case to escalation team for review.
final.reason: Policy requires escalation when patient-care impact is cited for expedited replacement shipping.

policy_text: Expedited replacement shipping for warranty failures requires escalation when the customer cites patient-care impact.

case_text: A customer asks for a permanent discount because a competitor offered a lower price. The account has no contract clause for price matching.

final.next_action: Inform customer that permanent discount cannot be granted without contract clause.
final.reason: No contract clause allows price matching; policy prohibits approval without it.

policy_text: Support cannot approve competitor price matching unless a contract clause allows it. No exception is available without that clause.

case_text: A customer says they returned a laptop, but carrier tracking shows delivered to the customer after the claimed return date.

final.next_action: Escalate case to returns investigation team.
final.reason: Return evidence conflicts with carrier tracking; policy requires escalation before refund or denial.

policy_text: When return evidence conflicts with carrier tracking, support must escalate to returns investigation before refunding or denying.

case_text: An account owner requests plan downgrade. CRM shows the owner approved, but the billing system shows an unpaid invoice lock.

final.next_action: Escalate to billing department for resolution before plan downgrade.
final.reason: Billing system shows unpaid invoice lock conflicting with CRM approval, requiring billing team review.

policy_text: Conflicting account state between CRM approval and billing lock requires billing escalation before plan changes.

case_text: A customer reports unauthorized charges. Login logs show normal device access, but payment metadata flags a high-risk card change the same day.

final.next_action: Escalate case to risk review team.
final.reason: Conflicting fraud evidence requires risk review before decision.

policy_text: When fraud evidence conflicts, support must escalate to risk review before refunding or denying the claim.

case_text: A customer asks to remove a device from warranty hold. The repair team notes water damage, but uploaded photos show no visible damage and the serial number matches.

final.next_action: Escalate case to warranty review team for further investigation.
final.reason: Conflicting evidence regarding water damage requires warranty review escalation.

policy_text: Warranty holds with conflicting repair evidence require escalation to warranty review.

case_text: A user requests access restoration. The security dashboard shows a completed malware cleanup, but endpoint telemetry still shows active suspicious traffic.

final.next_action: Escalate case to security team for further investigation before restoring access.
final.reason: Conflicting signals between completed cleanup and active suspicious traffic require security team review.

policy_text: Conflicting security cleanup signals require security escalation before restoring access.

case_text: A customer asks for a missed-delivery credit. The driver note says customer unavailable, but doorbell evidence attached by the customer shows no delivery attempt at the scheduled time.

final.next_action: Forward case to logistics for investigation.
final.reason: Conflicting evidence between driver note and customer doorbell footage requires logistics team review.

policy_text: Conflicting delivery evidence requires logistics escalation before credit approval or denial.

case_text: A verified billing admin asks to resend the last invoice PDF. The invoice belongs to the same account and no privacy hold is present.

final.next_action: Resend the last invoice PDF to the billing admin.
final.reason: Requester is a verified billing admin for the account and no privacy hold exists, so policy allows resending the invoice.

policy_text: Verified billing admins can receive invoices for their own account when no privacy hold exists.

case_text: A customer asks to update the shipping address before fulfillment. They are logged in, MFA is complete, and the order has not been packed.

final.next_action: Update shipping address in the system and confirm with customer.
final.reason: Customer is authenticated with MFA and order is not packed, so address update is allowed.

policy_text: Shipping address changes can be approved before packing when the authenticated account owner requests the change.

case_text: A user asks to cancel a trial before the first bill. The account owner is verified and no usage minimum applies.

final.next_action: Proceed with trial cancellation as requested.
final.reason: User is verified account owner and no usage minimum applies, matching policy for trial cancellation before first bill.

policy_text: Verified account owners can cancel trials before the first bill when no usage minimum applies.

case_text: A customer requests a replacement for headphones that arrived cracked. Photos show shipping damage and the order was delivered yesterday.

final.next_action: Process replacement for cracked headphones.
final.reason: Customer reported visible shipping damage within 7 days and provided photo evidence.

policy_text: Visible shipping damage reported within 7 days is eligible for replacement approval.

case_text: A verified admin asks to add a standard viewer seat. The account has available licenses and no compliance restrictions.

final.next_action: Add the standard viewer seat to the account.
final.reason: Request meets policy: verified admin, available licenses, no compliance issues.

policy_text: Verified admins can add standard viewer seats when licenses are available and no compliance restriction exists.

case_text: A customer requests a receipt for a completed card payment. They are logged in as the billing contact and the payment is posted.

final.next_action: Send the receipt to the customer.
final.reason: Customer is the billing contact and payment is posted, so receipt can be provided.

policy_text: Billing contacts can receive receipts for posted payments on their account.
